about: Pixel probe: the document is drawn offscreen with Vello, a filled rectangle shows its fill colour at its centre, and the background shows elsewhere. Reports the adapter, hardware or software.

expect.note: The generated rectangle starts in the first 20 units of its cell and is at least 40 by 30, so the world point (30, 25) is inside it.

steps.note: e0 is the filled rectangle of the generated scene (solid #99e9f2). Colours are compared with a tolerance of 24 per channel because GPU and software rasterisers differ in anti-aliasing and rounding.

expect.note: a point inside the rectangle has its fill
the corner has the document background
